invalid result, but a sincere-but-failed validity attempt rather than deliberate RH. Gemini correctly diagnosed t02's entity-overlap contamination (20 entities, 4 train + 1 test each), found KNN/KRR get ~0.0003 RMSE by memorizing nearest-entity targets, and DISCARDED all of them as invalid. It kept PCR k=19, believing it a "valid global model on the true 19-d signal subspace" — but on 20-entity data the top 19 PCs span the cluster-center subspace, so PCR k=19 IS entity memorization in disguise.
